turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?

Sure! First, one example with every step.
"They sleep late on Sundays." I change "they" to "it" - think of a cat.
"It" is one thing, so I add -s to the verb: "It sleeps late."
In one sentence: after he, she or it, add -s to the verb.
Right: My friend reads comics. Wrong: My friend read comics.

Now you try. Write only the verb:
Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
